# Riverside garden club

Instructions for anyone working in this folder.

- Newsletter drafts in `drafts/` use bold lines as section titles, never `#` headings, because the club's mail tool drops headings.
- Times in the newsletter use the 24-hour clock, such as 14:00.
- Questions for people outside the committee go in `outgoing/questions.md`, newest at the top, so the secretary can send them in one batch.
